# Orvio 0.32

- TV player: OK while watching shows the info screen (what you are watching, the buttons and the time bar) instead of pausing straight away; OK again pauses.
- TV player: the arrows move between the buttons. Go down to the time bar (it gets a gold outline) and Left/Right jump one minute back or forward. Live TV still zaps with up/down.
- Profiles: avatars that were cut off in the picture set are no longer offered; a profile that already uses one keeps it.
